notes.title: Regarding Slow Loading and Choppiness in Some Scenes
notes.content:
If the game loads unusually slowly or if some scenes are choppy, the culprit may be the shader cache* generated by the GPU driver.
Clearing the cache may resolve this issue. If not, try disabling the shader cache.

*The shader cache is operated by the GPU driver, so it cannot be controlled from within programs, such as Hajimari no Kiseki.
You will need to clear and/or configure the following settings specific to your hardware.

■NVIDIA GPUs (GeForce, etc.)
The shader cache is stored in the following folder:
C:\ProgramData\NVIDIA Corporation\NV_Cache
Please delete the files in this folder.

To disable the shader cache, right-click on the Windows desktop, open the NVIDIA Control Panel, and under Manage 3D Settings, turn Shader Cache to Off.

■AMD GPUs (Radeon, etc.)
You can delete or disable the shader cache by right-clicking on the Windows desktop and selecting AMD Radeon Software.
To delete the shader cache, refer to Reset Shader Cache on the following page:
https://www.amd.com/en/support/kb/faq/dh2-012

To disable the shader cache, refer to Shader Cache on the following page:
https://www.amd.com/en/support/kb/faq/dh-012

■Intel GPUs (HD Graphics, Iris, etc.)
The shader cache is stored in the following folder:
C:\ProgramData\Intel\ShaderCache
Please delete the files in this folder.

If you cannot see the contents of the ProgramData folder, check View -> Hidden Files in the Explorer menu.

■DirectX Shader Cache
In addition to deleting the GPU shader cache above, please also try deleting the DirectX shader cache.
Right-click [Local Disk (C:)] in Explorer and select [Properties].
Click [Disk Cleanup (D)] in the [General] tab of the Properties dialog.
If [DirectX Shader Cache] is not [0 bytes] on the right side, uncheck the other boxes, check [DirectX Shader Cache] only, and click [OK].
Click [Delete Files] when the Are you sure you want to delete these files? confirmation dialog appears.

If you are using Discord at the same time, the following settings may be affected.
Click the gear icon at the bottom of the screen and go to User Preferences and try the following:
・Click on [Audio/Video] and turn off [H.264 Hardware Acceleration] in the settings section.
・Click [Overlay] and turn off [Enable Overlay in Game] in the settings section.

If the above does not help, please also see the information provided here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1562940/view/2942527343050480630

The effectiveness of the shader cache depends on your PC configuration, but if you have a high performance CPU and plenty of memory, disabling it may improve performance.
Also, even on the same PC, the status of the shader cache changes depending on the history of the games you have played, so the occurrence of problems may vary depending on the games you play.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
We hope you continue to enjoy playing The Legend of Heroes: Hajimari no Kiseki.

notes.title: Patch Release Announcement(11/9)
notes.content:
The latest version of the update patch is now available. 

The main changes and bug fixes are as follows:
-Presets to the Hajimari no Kiseki Config that can be launched from the Steam client
 Presets are now available in Low, Medium, High, and Highest, depending on your PC specs.
-Added settings for hold function in High-Speed Skip mode
 This setting is enabled only while the High-Speed Skip Mode button is being held.
-Added ON/OFF switch for motion blur during field movement
-Mouse button assignment can now be changed in settings
-Menu can now be operated with movement keys (default setting: WASD)
-Minor tweaks to C: White Knight Ver., depending on the progress of the scenario
-Added C: White Knight Ver. cut-in when using S-Craft

notes.title: Resolution Settings Fix
notes.content:
The Hajimari no Kiseki Config resolution setting bug in Steam, which allowed players to select an invalid resolution in the Windows 10 display settings, has been fixed.
After the fix, the Hajimari no Kiseki Config resolution setting will display a resolution that is lower than those which can be selected in your Windows 10 display settings.
If you have selected an invalid resolution NOT shown in the modified Hajimari no Kiseki Config, please reset your resolution.
Additionally, if you are using a widescreen display larger than 16:9, you may need to change the scaling settings on your display in order to play the game in the correct aspect ratio.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

notes.title: [Important Notice] About the load speed issues
notes.content:
Load speed while playing Hajimari no Kiseki under certain conditions may be extremely slow. 
Please follow these steps to try and resolve the issue:

■ Update Windows 10 operating system and your video/graphics drivers 
Try updating your video card drivers, as oftentimes outdated drivers can cause a variety of issues.
In addition, please confirm if you have installed the latest system updates for Windows 10.

■ Add Hajimari no Kiseki files and folders to your anti-virus software's exception list
Some launching and performance issues may be attributed to certain Anti-Virus software deleting game files.
Adding all of the game files and folders to the Anti-virus's exception list may prevent this issue. 

Adding folders to the exception list:
・Open Steam client and go to [Library]. Select Hajimari no Kiseki and click the gear icon, then select [Manage] - [Browse local files]. Add the folders listed to the exception list.

・Open the Win64 folder in the bin folder where the game's executable file [ed8_ps5_D3D11.exe] is located. Please add the file to the exception list as well.

・Once you have registered the files to the exception list, proceed with the Verify integrity of game files process below.

*For a guide on adding exceptions, please refer to the manual of your anti-virus software, or contact the manufacturer of the anti-virus software.  


■Verify integrity of game files
Open Steam client and go to [Library]. Select Hajimari no Kiseki and click the gear icon, then select [Properties].
Select [LOCAL FILES] from the opened window, then click the [Verify integrity of game files...] button to start the game file verification process. The process may take some time.
After the process is completed, the Steam client will repair the corrupted game files automatically.

■Give administrator privileges to Steam and the game
In some situations, administrator privileges will be required to get the game running properly.
Follow the steps below to setup Administrator Privileges.

1) Click the gear icon for The Legend of Heroes: Hajimari no Kiseki in the Steam library, and select Manage -> Browse Local Files.
2) In Explorer, open the folder in which Hajimari no Kiseki is installed and then go to bin -> Win64.
3) Right-click on ed8_ps5_D3D11.exe in the Win64 folder.
4) Click on Properties and go to the Compatibility tab. Check the "Run this program as administrator" checkbox, then click Apply.
5) Click OK to close the window and restart the game.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
And we hope you will continue to support Hajimari no Kiseki.

notes.title: Patch Release Note(8/28)
notes.content:
A patch has been released to address an issue where Rixia's Special Costume "Moonlight Wedding" and Lapis's Special Costume "The Magic Girl Magical Lapis" cannot be claimed in-game. 

Once the patch has been applied, the incorrect DLC items will be deleted, and the correct items will be rewarded when starting a new game or loading from a save file. 

Additionally, any items equipped that have not yet been purchased will be removed. 

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

notes.title: Slow Load Speed
notes.content:
Load speed while playing Hajimari no Kiseki on Steam under certain conditions may be extremely slow. 

The cause of this issue is currently being investigated, and a patch will soon be released to address it.

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

notes.title: About Incorrect Resolution Display Settings
notes.content:
Previously, if scale and layout in the Windows 10 display settings was set to anything other than 100%, Hajimari no Kiseki's resolution in Steam would not show correctly.

This issue has now been fixed.
If this bug affected you, please set your scale and layout to 100%. 

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: About screenshots in 4K resolution
notes.content:
It has come to our attention that 3840x2160 resolution screenshots taken via Steam when playing Hajimari no Kiseki in full screen mode are saved at 2560x1440 resolution.
This issue is currently being investigated. 
For now, if you would like to take a screenshot at 3840x2160 resolution via Steam, please use window mode. 
Alternatively, 3840x2160 resolution screenshots can be successfully taken in full screen mode using GeForce Experience. 
This method should also work for players using an NVIDIA video card.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
